_readme: Amenities and attributes of each room, entered by hand after checking the room in person.
Key = room number exactly as on the floor plan (e.g. "6313", "6207A").
Every field is optional: leave out what you haven't checked and the page shows 'Not checked'.
microwave: true if there is a microwave in the room, else false.
naturalLight: true if the room has windows to the outside, else false.
notes: free text, one short sentence.
checked: date you checked the room, "YYYY-MM-DD".
Copy the shape of _example into rooms; _example itself is ignored.

6313.notes: Classroom; open for study when no class is scheduled.
